name: dub.link
description: The modern link attribution platform. Loved by world-class engineering teams at Twilio, Zillow, Jobber, Vercel, Raycast, and more.
readme: Dub Links is the modern, open-source link attribution platform for short links and conversion tracking. Our platform powers 250M+ clicks and 12M+ links monthly, and is used by world-class engineering teams at Twilio, Zillow, Jobber, Vercel, Raycast, and more. Next.js – framework TypeScript – language Tailwind – CSS Prisma – ORM Upstash – redis Tinybird – analytics PlanetScale – database NextAuth.js – auth BoxyHQ – SAML/SSO Turborepo – monorepo Stripe – payments Resend – emails Vercel – deployments
